svg.text: Bloomberg calendar-year estimates in US$bn | Jan - Oct 2026
Combined total | Samsung + SK Hynix + Micron + TSMC
All four companies on a calendar-year basis | US$bn
Source: Bloomberg Desktop API, BEST_CAPEX, USD override. Retrieved 29 Oct 2026.
Micron uses Bloomberg fixed blended calendar years: 26BC / 27BC / 28BC. Peers use December fiscal years, equal to calendar years.
Annual consolidated capex; Samsung includes non-memory businesses. USD history includes FX movements.
Totals sum the latest available historical observations, starting when all four have data. No backfilling before first coverage.
Lines connect available observations; dashed tails connect historical series to current snapshots. Totals end at the sum of current snapshots.
